description: Implement Appliances screen with full CRUD: display list of appliances, add new, edit existing, delete with confirmation. Each appliance edit form includes: name, category dropdown, wattage, voltage, current, daily hours, operating days (M-Su checkboxes), ON/OFF toggle. Depends on FEAT-003 ApplianceService, FEAT-004 navigation.
steps: Implement form fields: TextFormField for name, DropdownButton for category (fan, light, TV, refrigerator, rice cooker, AC), TextFormField for wattage (validation: > 0), optional voltage and current TextFormFields, TextFormField for dailyOperatingHours (0-24 validation), Row of 7 CheckBox for operating days (Mon-Sun), Switch for ON/OFF status
Add 'Calculate Wattage' button that computes watts from voltage*current if both provided
Implement form validation and error messages
On save: if id exists, update appliance via ApplianceService; otherwise add new
Display ListView of appliances with ListTile or custom card per appliance
Each item shows: name, category icon, wattage
Add action buttons: Edit (opens add_edit_appliance_screen in edit mode), Delete (shows confirmation dialog)
Floating Action Button to add new appliance
On delete confirmation, remove via ApplianceService and refresh UI
acceptance_criteria: Add new appliance: form works, saves to storage, appears in list
Edit appliance: form prefills current values, save updates storage and list
Delete appliance: confirmation dialog shown, appliance removed from list and storage
Form validation: wattage required and > 0, hours 0-24, name required
Voltage/current optional but if both provided, 'Calculate Wattage' button computes watts
Category dropdown shows all 6 appliance types
All changes persisted via ApplianceService to SharedPreferences
verification: Run: flutter analyze lib/screens/appliances_screen.dart lib/screens/add_edit_appliance_screen.dart — no errors

Run: flutter run and manually verify: tap '+' FAB, fill form, save, see appliance in list; tap edit, change name, save, see update; tap delete, confirm, appliance removed; restart app and verify appliance still there (persistence)
